caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile pattern composed of repeating floral motifs arranged in a grid. Each square of the grid features a large, stylized flower with red petals and a yellow center, surrounded by dark green leaves with red-tipped ends. Smaller flower buds, primarily red with green stems, are also present near the leaves within each square. Along the top and right borders, there is a decorative horizontal band displaying alternating large red flowers similar to those in the grid and green stems with small leaves and buds. The overall composition uses a color palette predominantly of red, green, and yellow on a light beige or off-white background, and the drawing is bordered by a thin red outline.
title: Appliqued Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
